status: the Windward Deep's city shell and Hoopa's relic area surface, generated. Built into build/ only; not yet run on staging, not seen in game.
ground: Every position comes from the pit's ring model (tools/rift_deep.py model() and lift_sites(): the owner's traced region, the canonical heightmap and data/rift_deep.json) and, for the relic area, from its traced region and tools/ground.py. Never from a world.

scope.built: the ring streets' dressing, riser buildings for the families on every ring, the Compact's HQ as the dominant building, stair towers round every lift bank and the Sink Gate, the Core spire grown as Heaven's Arena's drum (seven tier annuli, the crown, the stair's openings; no fights) and its bridges, the lighting layers L1-L7, the Centre and Mart, and the relic area's capped surface (the sealed entrance, the lookout and the dig; the shrine went underground 2026-10-02, relic_area.capped)
not_built: Hoopa's cradle, the cradle passage, the HQ's basement and its secure shaft: reserved volumes below, sealed rock, carved by nobody until Codex's story data exists
the confrontation and every room's dressing: the rooms are empty shells, labelled here

the relic cavern's interior: the cavern stays sealed (2026-10-03: the cradle chamber is generated by tools/relic_underground.py, data/relic_underground.json geometry.cradle, held behind its `carve` key until its independent audit is extended; the HQ's basement and secure shaft have been that file's since 2026-10-02. docs/world-building/DEEP_STATUS.md)
L8 holo-signs (text_display entities) and L9 motion: entities and a tick loop, each needing its own proof first (DEEP_CITY.md section 9)
NPCs, the Mart clerk and the Compact's people: entities, placed by their own steps
the Slip (the barrier between the dig camp and the relic area): a sculpt stroke in the heightmap and an owner decision (DEEP_CITY.md section 6); the cordon here is only the Compact's fence

decisions.call: DEEP_CITY.md section 10, decisions 1-4 taken by their recommended default so the shell could be built; 5-10 left open and not built
decisions.why: 1: built-in light for the Deep only. 2: static light, no redstone, so no Rotom in the Works. 3: no long glass span to the north promenade. 4: the HQ's sited point kept as its basement under the west riser block. 5 (adventure mode), 6 (a waystone), 7 (Hoopa after release), 8 (the barrier), 9 (the Key Stone) and 10 (the zone line) change nothing built here and are the owner's.

decisions.call: the future from what the pack has: dressed concrete panels, waxed copper and tinted glass, lit from inside by vanilla emitters and the Rift's own violet block
decisions.why: Nothing in the pack is futuristic. What reads as future in Minecraft is clean monolithic surfaces, exposed engineered metal, glass and light built into the fabric instead of hung on it. Every block below exists in vanilla 1.21.1 or was already placed on staging by an audited build.

decisions.call: every riser is lined with buildings whose ground floor is on the lower street and whose roof is flush with the street above
decisions.why: DEEP_CITY.md section 3: the city reads as one across all five elevations. The roofs become the upper street's outer terrace, which also gives the lumymon lifts a floor to land on (see lift_landings).

decisions.call: each lift bank is wrapped by a stair tower sited so the up-lift lands on the tower's roof and the down-lift lands inside the tower
decisions.why: Read from data/rift_deep.json: a lift moves a player by yOffset at the same column. The lower lift stands against the riser, so its target 17 up is open air over the lower ring (a fall), and the upper lift's target 17 down is inside the upper ring's rock. Riding was never proven; with the towers both ends land on floor if it works, and the stairs work if it does not.

decisions.call: the walkable way between rings is a spiral stair round a light core in every tower, plus a ladder and a hand-opened copper roof hatch in every family building
decisions.why: An honest vanilla mechanism: stairs and ladders need no proof. Water elevators were rejected because water is a spawn condition for 84 species (DEEP_CITY.md section 7); scaffolding because a stack 17-66 tall reads as construction, not a city.

decisions.call: on the Core's floor, buildings stand against every face that rises from it (the 66 north face and the ends of rings 1-3) with their roofs flush with the ring above
decisions.why: The sheer side is 25,518 columns of bare floor under a 66-block face. Buildings against it make the city span every elevation there too, and give the north promenade (ring 0) a terrace over them. None within the Victory Road mouth plaza.

decisions.call: the League's unused re-materialed CobbleTowns Centre and Mart (MIT, committed) on ring 0 beside the Sink Gate, placed by /place template with their jigsaws replaced by their final states and their flowers cleared
decisions.why: DEEP_CITY.md section 1: the last Centre and Mart before the League. Deepslate tiles and cyan terracotta suit the pit; the healing machines and PCs are whitelisted for service buildings in data/spawn_block_policy.json. The flowers are cleared: a garden in the pit is not a decision anyone made.

decisions.call: the HQ is the west sector of rings 0-3 and the floor below them, its tower on ring 0 over (3427, 3308)
decisions.why: rift_regions.json sites the HQ at (3427, 0, 3308) and DEEP_CITY.md owner decision 4 recommends keeping it as the basement under a west riser block. The HQ's sections are its public faces; the basement and shaft stay reserved rock.

decisions.call: the cradle is taken as sited in data/rift_regions.json, under the relic area at (3357, 3306), floor y12
decisions.why: docs/story/FACTION.md still places the cradle beneath the League plateau at (3297, 2603). data/rift_regions.json and DEEP_CITY.md (both later) put it under the relic area. This build follows the later siting and reports the disagreement; it builds nothing at either.

decisions.call: district and lift signs are wall signs (blocks), not text_display entities
decisions.why: The brief: blocks only. L8 needs a re-apply step for entities and a proof that one survives it.

decisions.call: Heaven's Arena is the Core spire grown upward (arena): radius 16, seven tier annuli at y15-y117 on the pit's own 15-then-17 grammar, the crown at y128, the existing 7x7 light core and spiral stair as its spine, the existing y15 bridge as tier 1's door
decisions.why: HEAVENS_ARENA.md site A. Measured here, not assumed: at radius 16 the drum eats 17 columns of the lot zone and the per-district lot counts are unchanged (rimside 69, works 38, quarter 29, relay 20, core 8, stacks 27, hq 5 = 196 before and after), so 0 buildings and 0 stair towers are paid. What is lost is the spire as generated (radius 8, top y100, 6 decks); it is generated, not authored. Two readings of the design's crown were open and this build takes one: the stair reaches the crown deck, the shaft's walls stop one below it, so the crown is a 33-across terrace with the light column and the beacon at its middle and no shaft above the top tier. The fights are not built.

decisions.call: one beacon, on the spire, on a 3x3 gold base, beam turned cyan by a stained glass block
decisions.why: DEEP_CITY.md L6. Iron beacon bases are banned (Meltan); gold is not a spawn condition. Its beam in this pack's client is NOT VERIFIED.

decisions.superseded: 2026-10-02: the owner rejected the fence ('THE RELIC SITE UNDERGROUND, reachable only through the Compact HQ, turned back by the zone check rather than barriers', 2026-10-01). The cordon is no longer built; the zone check is data/relic_underground.json's, and R9RU takes the built fence off a world that has it. Kept here, not deleted, because it records a call the owner has reversed.
decisions.call: the relic area is ringed by the Compact's cordon (tinted glass under iron bars, copper posts with end rods), seen through, not entered; its gate faces the Deep and stays shut
decisions.why: DEEP_CITY.md section 5: before the finale the shrine is inside a Compact cordon, seen, not entered. The zone check (RIFT_ZONES.md section 4) is the real enforcement; the fence is the physical edge.

panel_white.why: a clean monolithic panel is what reads as modern; vanilla concrete draws Varoom and Revavroom in every overworld biome, Moar Concrete's byte-identical texture draws nothing (data/spawn_block_policy.json)

panel_black.why: the Compact's authority in the darkest panel the pack has, same spawn reason

panel_cyan.for: the Works' accents and the Mart's district
panel_cyan.why: the Compact's machinery colour, same spawn reason

rib_teal.for: piers, corners and the spire's ribs everywhere
rib_teal.why: verdigris copper reads as engineered metal that has been there a while; waxed, so it never changes again, and copper conditions no spawn

copper_warm.why: fresh copper is warm: homes, not machinery

tuff_stone.for: the Quarter's walls and the relic shrine
tuff_stone.why: a grey stone softer than blackstone; the 1.21 tuff family has bricks and chiseled forms for detail

deep_stone.why: the rock of the pit, dressed

tread.for: roofs that are streets, bridge decks
tread.why: the Deep's own tread block (data/rift_deep.json), so a roof reads as the street it is; placed on staging

tread_edge.why: the Deep's own edge block, placed on staging

glass_dark.for: the HQ's curtain walls and conduit casings
glass_dark.why: you can see it is glass and cannot see in: the Compact's secrecy, and it keeps the conduits' light inside the channel

glass_conduit.why: L4: the machinery colour round a sea lantern core

glass_band.why: violet is raw Rift energy (DEEP_CITY.md section 4)

rail.for: every edge where a walk surface drops two or more
rail.why: L2's railing: a glass balustrade, connections set explicitly so a fill never leaves a row of posts

bars.for: the relic cordon, HQ grilles, signal masts
bars.why: iron bars condition nothing; iron BLOCKS draw Meltan and are never used

hatch.why: a copper trapdoor opens by hand in 1.21 (an iron one needs redstone), and an open trapdoor over a ladder of the same facing is climbable

door_sealed.why: an iron door with no button is shut to everyone: sealed until the story gives it a mechanism

seal.for: the relic entrance's seal (the shaft hatch it also made was removed 2026-10-02: it lay under the HQ section's wall, and the shaft now opens by a stair, data/relic_underground.json geometry.hq)
seal.why: the hardest block a player can meet in survival, drops nothing: a physical seal

ancient_stone.why: older than the Compact: native masonry, not panels

distortion.why: the Rift's own stone (data/rift_skin.json palette, placed on staging)

hoopa_gold.for: the relic ring and its fragments
hoopa_gold.why: Hoopa's rings are gold; raw gold reads as found, not forged, and conditions no spawn

rift_seep.for: keystones and inlays at the shrine

lights.rule: blocks only, never minecraft:light (docs/STATE.md: places are lit as towns, never light blocks). Built into the fabric: the Deep departs from lanterns on posts, which is DEEP_CITY.md owner decision 1.

bulb.why: a copper bulb keeps its lit state with no redstone attached

particle.why: L1, the tread grid tools/rift_deep.py already lays

crystal.why: L5 accent on the spire; placed on staging as the skin's vein cores. Its light level is not read from the jar, so it counts for nothing in the model

layers.L1: the tread grid, every 13 (tools/rift_deep.py): kept, counted in the model
layers.L2: contour lines: a sea lantern flush in the floor at every third railing column, under the glass railing
layers.L3: riser bands: at the second storey's window line of every facade, pearlescent froglight alternating with purple glass
layers.L4: conduits: the light core of every stair tower (sea lantern in cyan and tinted glass) rising four above its roof, and the Works' street conduit
layers.L5: the spire's column and its dormant-crystal crowns
layers.L7: fixtures: end rods over doors, copper bulbs, lanterns and shroomlight in homes, the relic cordon's post lights

targets.why: DEEP_CITY.md section 4: 12 or more on every street and bridge (fightorflight calms Dark and Ghost at 12), 8 or more everywhere walkable. Modelled from the plan by manhattan distance with no occlusion, so optimistic next to walls: NOT a measurement.

lights.fill_in: where the fixtures leave a street cell under its target, a district light is set flush into the floor there, scanning in a fixed order, until every modelled cell meets it

streets.why: The treads are already paved (tools/rift_deep.py). A street is the band between the building fronts and the front row: a sidewalk in the district's paving along each facade, the tread between, a front row of stalls, pylons, benches or masts, and the railing at the drop.
streets.conduit_why: L4 in the Works: a flush line of sea lanterns in cyan glass along ring 1's street, the veins' channel from the sink made into the city's supply

buildings.why: DEEP_CITY.md section 3: a 16-block frontage and a building about as deep, leaving a street of 10-20 and a front row on a 36-wide tread. Storeys of 5 give three floors in a 17 riser. Lots are cells of seeds sown along the risers, so they follow the pit's traced curve instead of a grid.

quarter.name: The Quarter
quarter.character: where the families live; warm light only

stacks.name: The Stacks
stacks.character: the families' tower blocks against the north face, their roofs the north promenade

hq.name: The Compact's HQ
hq.character: one building down the west risers

plaza.why: The Core's floor on the sheer side is bare rock at y0 (tools/rift_deep.py lays no tread there). Paved flush at y0 in dressed deepslate with a basalt grid, so the floor reads as the city's lowest square, not the bottom of a hole.

towers.why: One stair tower round every lift bank (DEEP_CITY.md section 3): a 5x5 spiral stair round a 3x3 light core, 16 steps a turn, inside a 7x7 wall. The riser is 15 or 17, so the last step always lands on the back row, beside the wall the player steps over onto the street above.

sink_gate.why: DEEP_CITY.md finding 1: there is no way from the Rift floor (y83) down to ring 0. The Sink Gate is a stair tower from the lip to ring 0 where the approach from the sink arrives; every ring-0 building's ladder and hatch is a second way down.

services.why: Rimside holds the Centre and Mart by the Sink Gate (DEEP_CITY.md section 3), so an arriving player finds them first.

spire.why: DEEP_CITY.md section 3: 15-21 across on the floor core, a glass shell over a light column, rising to about y100 so its top shows over the lip from the Rift floor; bridges at y15 to Relay Row. Sited at the floor column furthest from every riser. The long glass span to the north promenade (owner decision 3) is not built.
spire.grown_into: arena: when this key is present the spire is built as Heaven's Arena's drum. The spire's own radius and top are then unused; its siting rule, its bridges at y15 and its light column are not.

arena.name: Heaven's Arena
arena.site: A, the Core spire grown upward: the one large footprint the city's own lot rule (dist < 16 from a riser foot) leaves empty, so 0 of 196 buildings and 0 of 9 stair towers are displaced
arena.why: HEAVENS_ARENA.md sections 3 and 4: the pit's own vertical grammar is 15 then 17, so seven tiers land exactly on the five street levels (y0-y66), the lip (y83) and two above it (y100, y117). Radius 16 (33 across) round the existing 7x7 light core and its spiral stair makes every tier an annulus r=4..15, 11 wide, which keeps the light column unbroken (L5 the spine, L6 the crown). The crown at y128 is the view and the beacon, 4 under the HQ tower's y132, so the Compact's tower stays the dominant building.
arena.lift: nothing new below y66: the city is the lift. The nine stair towers and eight lift pairs reach every street, the existing y15 bridge from Relay Row is tier 1's door, and the spiral stair round the light core runs the lobby to the crown with an opening onto every tier.
arena.stands_why: One 3x3 cell per tier is reserved on the annulus, across the floor from that tier's stair door, and the build fails if anything is written into it. The cell is geometry only: it carries no trainer, no yaw, no faces, no eye_contact and no sight_distance.
not_built: the fights: no trainer, no ladder, no prize, no per-player tier state. Whether rctmod can hold an endless ladder rests on an unproven gate (docs/research/notes/rct-arena-capabilities.md, experiment A1: whether requiredDefeats gates a trainer with series []). Principle 20: the geometry and the fights are separable and stay separated.
the tier-5 outside terrace at the lip (y83), the second bridge at y32 to the Quarter, and the lift's per-tier requiredAdvancement: each is an open question in HEAVENS_ARENA.md section 9.
seating, dressing and signage inside the drum: empty shells, as everywhere else in this build.

hq.floor_bearing_why: On the floor the west sector is narrow: the ring-3/floor lift tower and the spire's west bridge take most of it, and the window the rings use left the HQ's lower hall 41 columns. Widened southward on the floor only, so the hall the confrontation may use is a hall.
hq.symbol: an open ring crossed by a short bridge (docs/story/FACTION.md), in sea lanterns on the tower's face towards the city
hq.cordon: iron bars on a tinted-glass course round the HQ's lower door on the Core (DEEP_CITY.md section 3)
hq.why: The dominant building: its sections take the west sector's riser lots on every ring and the floor, all in black panel and tinted glass, and its tower rises 48 over the lip from the ring-0 section, over the sited HQ column.

sign.why: the owner flew the Deep and could not find the HQ's way in. The door is one iron door among 196 buildings; the guard (data/relic_underground.json geometry.hq.guard) stands one block SOUTH of the doorstep, so the sign hangs one block NORTH of the door on the facade at head height, and the doorstep and the guard's cell stay clear. A wall sign is a block (DEEP_CITY.md: signs are blocks, not text_display entities)

rooms.note: the head of the secure shaft to the basement at (3427, 0, 3308). Since 2026-10-02 the shaft is a stair from this room's south-west corner (3429, 66, 3299) down to the Compact's records room at y0, carved by tools/relic_underground.py R9RU (data/relic_underground.json geometry.hq), which also lays a pressure plate either side of this room's iron door. The reinforced-deepslate hatch this build used to lay lay under the room's west wall and is gone.
anchor control on the HQ's Relay Row front (DEEP_CITY.md section 3)
the HQ's lower door on the Core, inside the cordon; the likeliest stage for the confrontation, whose staging waits on Codex
the tower's storeys, empty; no way in is built
where the veins from the sink enter the city

reserved.why: the relic cavern: Hoopa's cradle, sited at (3357, 3306) floor y12 under the relic area (data/rift_regions.json sited.hoopa_cradle), 40 either way for a chamber and the Displaced City's 24-block rock shell (tools/cavern_plan.py precedent), up to y72, 14 under the lowest relic ground. Sealed: nothing is written here.
the 70-block passage from the HQ basement to the cradle, climbing 12 (data/rift_regions.json sited.cradle_passage)
the HQ's basement at (3427, 0, 3308) (data/rift_regions.json sited.haven_compact_hq), under ring 0's rock
the secure shaft from the HQ's ring-0 front down to the basement (DEEP_CITY.md section 5), in the rock under ring 0's tread

2026-10-02: the secure shaft's head. hq_secure_shaft was drawn for a tower at x3422-3432; the built tower is x3428-3438 and has no door, and no column of the ring-0 section's storey-0 room (hq_secure_shaft_head) is over the shaft. So the stair starts in that room's south-west corner (x3429, z3299) and runs south under the room's and the tower's walls into the shaft. Carved by tools/relic_underground.py R9RU (data/relic_underground.json geometry.hq); this build writes nothing here, and fails closed if it ever does.

2026-10-02 integration: with the city's pack built, the relic audit's doorstep walk reached the sealed storey-0 room WITHOUT the guard: north along the ring-0 street, in at the next HQ section's own street door (3445, 67, 3252), south through that section, and into the room across z3278, where nothing divides the two (the city writes no cell at x3431-3443 z3278 y67-70). The two HQ builders could not see it: their worktrees had no built city pack, so the walk started at the passage. One wall across that line makes the guard the only way in. Written by tools/relic_underground.py R9RU (carve/40_hq); this build writes nothing here, and fails closed if it ever does.

mouth_tunnel.why: Victory Road's mouth tunnel (data/vr_caves.json mouth, 7 wide, floor y1): nothing written

mouth_plaza.why: the plaza before Victory Road's mouth (DEEP_CITY.md section 3): open floor, nothing standing on it

keep_clear.why: The Deep's floor exit is Victory Road's mouth; its other paths are the lift banks. Nothing is written in the mouth tunnel or over the plaza before it, and nothing into a lift block or the two blocks a rider stands in.

capped.why: the relic site is underground (the owner, 2026-10-01). The surface keeps only the Compact's cap: the sealed entrance, the lookout and the dig. The shrine, the arches, the ring and the stones are in data/relic_underground.json's hall, and the cordon is replaced by that file's zone check. shrine and stones below are still READ by tools/deep_city.py, writing nothing, because the dig's placement is keyed to their footprints and the dig a world already holds must not move.
capped.undo: R9RU (tools/relic_underground.py) takes the old surface build off a world that has it, derived from tools/relic_surface_superseded.py

shrine.why: the widest ground of the traced area, on its waist, between the cradle (west) and the Deep's lip (east). NOT BUILT since 2026-10-02 (capped); its footprint is what the dig keeps clear of

superseded_surface.why: NOT BUILT since 2026-10-02 (capped). Kept, not deleted, because tools/relic_surface_superseded.py reads them to know what the old build wrote, which is what R9RU takes off a world

arches.why: DEEP_CITY.md section 5: six standing ring arches 7-9 tall, Distortion stone with crying-obsidian and purple-glass inlay

ring.why: the relic ring on its central plinth: 17 across on a 3-block plinth, so it stands over 20 above the shrine and shows against the sky from the dig camp 250 blocks west. Broken: a gap where a fragment is missing

cordon.why: the Compact's fence round the whole traced area, gate shut towards the Deep

sealed_entrance.why: a sunken forecourt four down to a doorway sealed with reinforced deepslate behind iron bars, on the cradle's side of the shrine. Nothing is carved behind the seal.

lookout.why: the terrace looking down over all five rings (DEEP_CITY.md section 5), at the traced area's east edge over the lip, with a paved processional way to it from the shrine

stones.why: standing stones round the shrine, native work older than the Compact, two of them fallen: the site reads as old from the dig camp's side before the ring does. NOT BUILT since 2026-10-02 (capped; the stones stand in the hall at orbit 19, data/relic_underground.json); their footprints are what the dig keeps clear of

debris.why: the Compact's dig: survey trenches, spoil heaps, fallen ring fragments, crates
